For target port that register itself as both FCP + NVMe
will try to login one mode at a time. If the last mode did not succeed
then driver will try the other mode.

column2: current code only flip to other mode one time

column1: (NVMe->FCP) and remain on the last mode.  Driver wrongly assumed target
port does not support PRLI NVMe
column2: instead it was not ready to receive PRLI.

column1: This patch will alternate back and forth on every PRLI failure until login
retry count has depleted or it is succeeded.
